decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit is very close to the firm's established plural-component and injection-equipment knowledge, so management is likely to keep refining it rather than withdraw it.
As another resin injection unit within the firm's core application-technology domain, it fits existing engineering, manufacturing and service capabilities and is therefore likely to be retained.
An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's long-standing spray-application expertise, giving management strong capacity to learn from customer feedback and improve it.
A manual airless spray gun is highly aligned with the firm's core gun and coating-equipment business, making it one of the easiest products to support and sustain.
The air-assisted airless spray gun extends a familiar product family, so the firm can absorb market information effectively and has good reason to keep it on the market.

The data logger is more distant from the firm's mainly mechanical application-equipment knowledge base, and its reduced web prominence by 2019 suggests weaker traction and less confidence in further development.
